sayLog.line: 🐗 RAID — 5 raiders (Drum-Belly, Rut King, Nevermore, The Living Wire, Choir Toad) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! No walls. No warning but the noise.
🛡️ Rocco, Daniela, Sari, Emma and Ruth met them at the door — 2 put down, 3 driven off. Sari, Ruth are hurt.
◈ CRISIS — THE SIEGE. They came in the night for the pantry — and the village met them at the door with blades and fire and drove them back into the dark. Wealth has a scent. So does defiance.
🛟 Rocco stands up by the fire. "Nobody's saying it, so I will: we need a plan, tonight. Here's what we CAN do — pick one, maybe two, but everything costs something."
🐗 RAID — 5 raiders (Extended Warranty, The Moderator, The Anaconda Empress, The Paparazzo, White Noise) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! No walls. No warning but the noise.
🛡️ Rocco, Tanya, Diego, Daniela and Emma met them at the door — 4 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Rocco, Diego are hurt.
🛟 Ruth stands up by the fire. "Nobody's saying it, so I will: we need a plan, tonight. Here's what we CAN do — pick one, maybe two, but everything costs something."
⛺ Triage tents go up. Ruth runs them — broth, boiled water, clean bandages, no sleep. (-800 kcal from the pantry, said aloud and spent.)
🛟 Salvatore stands up by the fire. "We can't just watch the fever in the tents happen. Here's what we CAN do — pick one, maybe two, but everything costs something."
